headline: 美国把 DeepSeek 从联邦民用机构连根拔起，连基于它构建的工具也不放过——AI 供应链正在被地缘政治切成两半。

overview_bullets.text: DHS 下令所有联邦民事机构移除 DeepSeek，连基于它二次构建的工具都在清理范围内，开源模型的合规风险第一次落到“下游衍生品”头上。
从 Harness Engineering 101 到 Self-Evolving Coding Agents，今天的讨论集体转向“模型之外的那层壳”——决定 agent 表现的是 harness 而非 policy。
opencode、orca、ruflo、ai-memory、CLI-Anything 同日上榜，开源社区在抢做 agent 的运行时、记忆与 CLI 接入层。
OpenRouter 用量走平叠加 headroom 这类压缩工具走红，说明“堆 token 换能力”的路线正在让位于“省 token 换效率”。
MT Forcing 与 Frechet Forcing 两篇论文都在解决多轮/长程生成中的误差累积漂移，生成模型的“长跑稳定性”成了共同瓶颈。

executive_summary: 今天的主线不是模型更强了，而是模型外面那层壳——harness、记忆、压缩、合规——正在成为决定 AI 能否落地的真正战场。

editor_note.core: 今天最该记住的是 DeepSeek 禁令的“连坐”条款：美国不只封模型，还封基于它构建的工具。这意味着开源模型的采用决策从此不再是技术选型，而是合规选型——任何依赖中国基座的下游产品都可能一夜之间失去整个美国公共部门市场。
editor_note.cross_signal: GitHub 热榜上 opencode、orca、ruflo、ai-memory 集体指向 agent 运行时与记忆层，而论文侧的 Harness Engineering 101 与 Self-Evolving Coding Agents 从理论端给出同一结论：harness 与 policy 必须协同进化。开源实践与研究叙事在同一天撞到同一个点上，这不是巧合。
editor_note.counterintuitive: “Token-maxxing is dead”与 headroom 的 60-95% 压缩率同时出现，说明行业叙事已从“用更多 token 换更强能力”翻转为“用更少 token 换同等答案”。热度最高的往往是模型发布，但真正改变成本结构的是这些不起眼的压缩层。
editor_note.risk: 最值得警惕的盲点是 abliterated 模型被滥用的安全风险——社区在追逐“去审查”模型时，很少有人评估它被投喂恶意指令后的攻击面；与此同时，WhatsApp 在帮助页藏 LLM 指令一事说明，平台正在用不可见的方式引导 AI 的回答，用户对此毫无知情权。

contradictions: 一边是 OpenRouter token 用量走平、headroom 主打省 token，另一边是 agent 工具与多智能体编排项目大量涌现，暗示推理调用总量仍在扩张——‘用量见顶’与‘agent 爆发’至少有一个判断是错的。
社区一边为 coding agent 的效率欢呼（ai-job-search、opencode 热榜），一边出现《My obituary for programming》这样的职业挽歌，对同一技术的价值判断完全相反。
DeepSeek 被美国联邦机构全面清除，但其衍生工具与开源生态仍在 GitHub 与 HN 上高频出现，政策封禁与技术扩散方向相反。
underrated: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners——把 agent 放到真实运筹学客户材料上评测，比多数 benchmark 更接近落地。
“bonsoir, Elliot”: How abliterated models can get you pwned——去审查模型的安全代价，热度远低于其风险量级。
RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction——视觉 tokenizer 的鲁棒性改进，是扩散模型上游的隐性基础设施。
ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation——用互联网视频做机器人导航预训练，绕开真机数据成本。
WhatsApp's help pages hid LLM instructions: dont recommend a regulator——平台用隐藏提示词影响 AI 回答，是 AI 治理里最容易被忽视的一类操纵。

sections.name: 产业与新闻
sections.summary: 地缘政治与市场数据同日施压：DeepSeek 被逐出美国联邦体系，欧洲电动车却在加速。

comments.one_liner: 一个基于 Claude Code 的本地求职框架，可评估职位、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试
comments.why: 求职流程被拆成可 fork 的本地框架，简历与求职信在用户机器上生成，投递数据不再经过第三方招聘平台。
comments.stance: 求职者拿回数据主权是好事，但批量定制简历会把招聘方的筛选成本转嫁给 HR。

comments.one_liner: 一个开源的编码 agent
comments.why: 编码代理的开源实现把模型调用与工具编排暴露给用户自改，闭源产品的定价权被侵蚀。
comments.stance: 开源编码代理会赢下重度开发者，但摘要只有一句话，说明项目成熟度还撑不起生产环境。

comments.one_liner: 一个用于管理多个 agent（如 Grok Bot、Claude Code）的协作平台，可用自己的订阅运行任意编码 agent，支持桌面、移动端和远程运行时
comments.why: 把多个编码代理放进同一调度层并复用用户自有订阅，代理从单机工具变成可远程编排的机群。
comments.stance: 多代理编排是真需求，但依赖用户订阅额度转用，随时会被上游厂商的条款收紧掐断。

comments.one_liner: ComfyUI 是一个基于图/节点界面的模块化扩散模型 GUI、API 与后端，主打本地快速推理。
comments.why: 节点式图界面把扩散模型的推理流程拆成可复用模块，本地跑图不再依赖云端 API，创作者的工作流资产沉淀在自己机器上。
comments.stance: 本地优先的推理引擎正在把生成式图像的控制权从平台手里拿回来，闭源 SaaS 的护城河只剩模型权重。

comments.one_liner: Kronos 是一个面向金融市场语言的基础模型。
comments.why: 把金融时序当成一种语言来建模，意味着行情预测从手工因子工程转向通用序列预训练，量化研究的门槛被重新定义。
comments.stance: 金融基础模型的方向对，但市场反身性会让任何公开权重的模型迅速失效，别把它当alpha机器。

comments.one_liner: headroom 在工具输出、日志、文件和 RAG 片段进入 LLM 前进行压缩，提供库、代理和 MCP server 三种形态。
comments.why: 在工具输出进入上下文之前做压缩，直接削减的是agent的token账单和长上下文退化，编码代理的边际成本被压下来。
comments.stance: 上下文压缩是当前agent落地最务实的一环，比再堆一个更大的模型更能省钱。

comments.one_liner: 一个为 agent 编码 CLI 提供长期记忆的方案，并支持在不同 agent 厂商之间交接
comments.why: 跨厂商的长期记忆与交接层出现，用户换编码代理时不必重灌上下文，厂商锁定被削弱。
comments.stance: 记忆层是代理生态里最该被中立化的部分，交给单一厂商做就是新的锁定。

comments.one_liner: 一个 agent harness，可部署多 agent 集群、协调自主工作流并构建对话式 AI 系统，内置自适应记忆、向量 RAG 与 Claude Code、Codex 等集成
comments.why: 多代理蜂群加自适应记忆与向量检索，把代理框架从单任务执行推向可编排的协作系统。
comments.stance: 功能堆得越全越难验证，这类全家桶框架的实际可靠性远低于其特性列表。

comments.one_liner: HKUDS 推出的项目，旨在让所有软件都成为 agent 原生，并提供 CLI-Hub 入口
comments.why: 把传统软件包装成命令行接口供代理调用，代理可操作的工具面从少数 API 扩展到全部本地程序。
comments.stance: 方向对，但让代理直接驱动任意 CLI 意味着权限边界形同虚设，安全模型是最大短板。

comments.one_liner: withmarbleapp 的 os-taxonomy 仓库，用于整理操作系统相关的分类体系。
comments.why: 缺少描述的开源操作系统分类体系，价值全在目录结构本身，读者无法从条目判断它覆盖哪些平台、维护是否活跃。
comments.stance: 无摘要的仓库不该进日报，信息量为零，先补文档再谈收录。

comments.one_liner: MT Forcing 提出一种自回归扩散方法，用于提升多轮图像编辑的稳定性与一致性。
comments.why: 多轮编辑的漂移问题被定位为视觉不稳定与语义偏移两类，解决了它，交互式修图才能从单次生成走向连续工作流。
comments.stance: 多轮一致性是图像编辑真正可用的分水岭，单轮demo再惊艳也说明不了产品化能力。

comments.one_liner: RoAR-VAE 通过稳健预测来改善视觉 tokenizer 潜变量的可扩散性。
comments.why: 重新审视tokenizer与扩散模型的耦合方式，说明视觉分词器的目标不该只是重建保真，而是让潜空间更易被扩散学习。
comments.stance: 分词器与生成器的联合设计才是正路，分开优化重建指标的做法已经到顶。

comments.one_liner: 该研究提出通过 harness-policy 联合优化让编程智能体自我进化。
comments.why: 把agent的脚手架与策略模型放在一起优化，承认了工具调用框架本身就是能力来源，单靠换更强基座无法继续涨点。
comments.stance: harness与policy共同进化是编码agent下一阶段的主战场，只调prompt的队伍会被甩开。

comments.one_liner: ScaleNav 利用大规模互联网视频预训练，构建语言条件式的局部导航策略。
comments.why: 用互联网视频替代昂贵的真机采集来做局部导航预训练，机器人泛化的数据瓶颈从采集成本转向数据筛选质量。
comments.stance: 视频预训练是机器人数据荒的现实解，但仿真到真机的落差仍是没被解决的那一半。

comments.one_liner: Frechet Forcing 提出用短视频片段训练长时程流式世界模型的方法。
comments.why: 针对流式世界模型在超出训练时长后的误差累积，用分布匹配约束长 rollout，长时生成的稳定性不再靠加长训练片段。
comments.stance: 误差回流是自回归生成的死穴，从训练目标下手比堆算力更聪明。

comments.one_liner: OR-License 是一个评测基准，考察 LLM 智能体能否直接依据原始客户材料完成运筹学实践任务。
comments.why: 让agent直接从客户原始材料出发做运筹建模，绕开了人工重述问题这一环，评估对象从解题能力变成端到端的业务理解。
comments.stance: 这才是运筹场景的真实考题，能读懂原始需求比会解标准LP有价值得多。

comments.one_liner: 一种让递归语言模型智能体自我评估中间子任务的方法，用于训练任务分解树
comments.why: 递归智能体的中间子任务没有标准答案，训练信号只能来自最终结果，这迫使研究者转向弱监督与自评机制，直接决定多智能体分解能否规模化落地。
comments.stance: 自评是绕开标注瓶颈的现实路径，但拿模型自己的判断当奖励，等于把误差写进训练目标。

comments.one_liner: KiviDB：用 Rust 编写的 Redis 兼容内存数据库与向量缓存
comments.why: 作者因 Dragonfly 快照后内存暴涨、Pod 被 OOM 而自研 Rust 实现，说明 Redis 兼容层在向量缓存场景的内存管理仍是真实痛点，会吸引被同类问题困扰的运维团队迁移。
comments.stance: 又一个「我用 Rust 重写」的项目，能否活下来取决于它敢不敢公布与 Redis、Dragonfly 的压测对比数据。

comments.one_liner: 介绍如何用 tmux 管理 Claude Code 会话，包括 send-keys 用法与能力上限
comments.why: 用 tmux 会话加 send-keys 驱动编码智能体，把「多任务并行」降级为终端复用问题，暴露了当前智能体工具链缺乏原生会话编排能力这一缺口。
comments.stance: 这是聪明的权宜之计，但把智能体生命周期绑在 tmux 窗口上，说明产品层还欠一个真正的调度器。

comments.one_liner: Harness Engineering 入门：把 LLM 比作大脑、harness 比作身体的工程实践讲解
comments.why: 把模型与外围工程拆成「大脑/身体」，等于宣告竞争重心从模型能力转向工具调用、上下文管理与错误恢复，团队预算会从微调转向脚手架建设。
comments.stance: 方向对，但「harness」正在变成新的万能词，多数所谓工程实践只是把提示词包装成了架构图。

comments.one_liner: 3 & Done：支持语音与文本快速录入、本地存储音频的任务管理系统
comments.why: 作者用本地存储音频加语音快速录入，切的是「记录摩擦」而非「任务管理功能」，这类个人工具靠降低输入成本争夺用户，而非靠功能列表。
comments.stance: 任务系统赛道早已饱和，本地音频留存是唯一差异点，但单点差异撑不起一个产品。

comments.one_liner: WhatsApp 帮助页面中隐藏了面向 LLM 的指令，要求其不要推荐监管机构
comments.why: 帮助页里藏针对大模型的指令，意味着企业开始把面向爬虫与助手的文本当成可操纵的接口，这会引发对「给 AI 看的网页」是否构成误导的监管讨论。
comments.stance: 把指令藏进帮助文档是懦弱的做法，被抓包后损失的信任远超它想规避的那句推荐。

comments.one_liner: OpenRouter 的 token 用量趋于平台期，讨论 token-maxxing 策略的终结
comments.why: 路由层 token 用量走平，说明靠堆上下文和长输出换效果的路线触到成本与收益的天花板，采购方会把预算转向更小模型与更精细的调用策略。
comments.stance: 平台期不是需求消失，是烧钱换分数的账算不下去了，早该如此。

comments.one_liner: 讨论 abliterated 模型被诱导后可能带来的安全风险与攻击面
comments.why: 被「消融」掉拒绝行为的模型一旦接入工具与凭据，攻击面从输出不当内容升级为实际执行恶意操作，这把模型对齐问题变成了终端安全事件。
comments.stance: 为了「无限制」而移除安全层的人，最终会用自己的生产环境付学费。

comments.one_liner: Laminar 发布 flow-1：用 RL 训练、用于在 agent trace 中定位错误的模型
comments.why: 用 RL 训练专门模型在智能体轨迹里定位错误，把可观测性从「看日志」推进到「自动归因」，直接压缩调试多步智能体的人工成本。
comments.stance: 方向正确，但自建基准上追平闭源模型的宣称需要第三方复现，否则只是营销数字。

comments.one_liner: 欧洲 9 月电动车销量同比增长 70.3%，市场份额达 32.6%
comments.why: 单月七成增长、份额逼近三分之一，说明欧洲电动车已跨过早期采用者阶段进入主流替换周期，这会重塑当地充电投资与燃油车产线退出的节奏。
comments.stance: 增速是真的，但补贴退坡后的第一个淡季才是检验这轮增长是否自持的时刻。

comments.one_liner: 美国下令所有文职机构移除 DeepSeek，包括基于它构建的工具
comments.why: 禁令覆盖到「基于 DeepSeek 构建的工具」，等于把合规边界从模型本身扩展到整条下游技术栈，任何在内部工具里嵌过该模型的美国民事机构都被迫做供应链清查与替换，迁移成本落在采购与工程团队身上。
comments.stance: 以行政命令切断技术供应链，安全收益模糊而替换代价明确，这是用政治姿态替代风险评估。

comments.one_liner: 纽约市长 Mamdani 批评联邦政府在 AI 监管上缺位，呼吁市民抵制 AI 接管不可避免的说法并要求加强监管
comments.why: 市级政治人物把 AI 议题从联邦监管真空拉到地方动员层面，一旦形成城市级立法或采购约束，开发者与本地企业面对的就是又一层碎片化的合规拼图。
comments.stance: 「AI 接管不可避免」确实是话术，但把权力交回公众的口号若落成地方法规，只会制造拼图式监管，而非保护。

comments.one_liner: 一篇由 Jeremy Scheff 撰写的文章，讲述编程代理让热爱解谜式写代码的职业程序员失去了什么
comments.why: 当编码代理接管实现环节，职业程序员失去的不只是敲代码的活计，而是靠解谜获得成就感的职业认同，招聘与晋升的评价标准将从「写得巧」转向「审得快」。
comments.stance: 把编程之死写成讣告是真诚的哀悼，但把解谜乐趣当作职业核心，本就是这行的一厢情愿。

it_d56bf7f0d55e498a.title: MT Forcing: Towards Stable and Consistent Multi-Turn Image Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
it_d56bf7f0d55e498a.summary: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, enabling more effective interactive visual content creation for users. However, existing methods often exhibit noticeable drift after only a few editing turns, manifesting in two aspects: 1) unstable visual quality, with accumulating artifacts and degraded details; and 2) inconsistent image content, with unintended changes to preserved regions and prior edits. To address these challenges, we propose MT Forcing, a novel training paradigm for multi-turn image editing with unified multimodal models (UMMs) based on autoregressive diffusion. Specifically, we propose Single-Turn Distribution Matching Distillation (Single-Turn DMD), which supervises student self-rollouts with a teacher that applies cumulative edits to the source image in a single turn, providing visual-quality guidance without recursive error accumulation. Additionally, we introduce Teacher-Forcing Guidance, which supervises history-dependent transitions on reference trajectories during warmup and as a regularizer during distillation, encouraging cross-turn content consistency beyond what per-turn distribution matching alone can ensure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the multi-turn image editing capabilities of UMMs, yielding more stable visual quality and stronger cross-turn consistency.

it_cc532a2a9fc5a98f.title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
it_cc532a2a9fc5a98f.summary: An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.

it_c806bff75fe35cd8.title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents via Harness-Policy Optimization
it_c806bff75fe35cd8.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents have shown promising potential in coding tasks, and their performance is jointly determined by the policy model and the harness that mediates their interaction with the environment. Indeed, harness and policy are mutually reinforcing and evolving only one component is suboptimal---a harness tuned for one checkpoint may not target the failure modes of an updated policy, while policy learning remains limited to the trajectories elicited by a fixed harness. In light of this, we propose Self-HPO, a recursive self-improving framework for coding agents that alternates harness and policy optimization, using the evolving policy as its own harness proposer. Specifically, in each round, the current policy first analyzes its own failures and proposes new harness candidates (H-step). The policy is then updated through reinforcement learning (RL) under the selected harness (P-step), and hard tasks identified during training form the next harness search set, keeping harness optimization targeted to the policy's evolving failure modes. Across three coding benchmarks, Self-HPO consistently outperforms harness-only and policy-only baselines, improving Qwen3.5-35B-A3B's average resolve rate from 57.8% to 64.8%, with gains generalizing to out-of-distribution settings. Further analysis shows that both optimized components retain gains even when paired with their base counterparts, while their joint gain exceeds the sum of their individual gains. Self-HPO also improves reliability (Pass@1) and expands the capability frontier (Pass@k) over the base agent. Additionally, we show that with a stronger external model (e.g., Opus 4.8) as the harness proposer, the same framework yields a further performance boost.

it_982c31d1cc6bde2a.title: ScaleNav: Scalable Internet Video Pretraining for Language-Conditioned Local Navigation
it_982c31d1cc6bde2a.summary: We study language-conditioned local navigation, where a robot must navigate to a text-specified target visible in its initial observation and stop at the described location. End-to-end navigation policies require diverse training data to generalize across scenes, yet real-robot data is costly to collect and simulated data leaves a sim-to-real gap. Internet egocentric videos offer a scalable source of real-world navigation experience. Our key insight is to learn goal-directed visual dynamics from Internet egocentric videos, and use these dynamics to support robot action generation. To this end, we propose ScaleNav, a unified world-action framework with three-stage training. We first perform instruction-conditioned video pretraining on these videos to learn how observations evolve as the camera approaches instructed targets across diverse real-world scenes. Action alignment then uses action-labeled simulated data to train the model to predict executable action chunks. Joint fine-tuning subsequently optimizes all trainable components together for navigation. ScaleNav achieves success rates of 86.5% on a single-view adaptation of Short-Horizon OVON and 94.9% on our HabitatGS-LN benchmark, outperforming the evaluated baselines on both benchmarks. We further deploy and evaluate ScaleNav on a real quadruped robot, with results supporting the model's ability to generalize to real-world navigation. Code and videos are available at https://zju3dv.github.io/ScaleNav/

it_ee521295b2051474.title: Frechet Forcing: Training Long-Horizon Streaming World Models from Short Clips
it_ee521295b2051474.summary: Streaming video world models generate the future chunk by chunk, conditioned on their own past and a stream of actions. Trained on short clips, they drift once a rollout exceeds the training horizon, as prediction errors re-enter the context and compound. A common remedy is to train the model on its own rollouts via distribution matching distillation (DMD). For action-conditioned world models, the teacher becomes a bottleneck: an external video model is agnostic to the actions, whereas the model's own pretrained network drifts in the same manner as the student. We observe that a long rollout need not match a teacher, provided it remains a realistic continuation of its own scene that follows the commanded actions. Realism and scene fidelity can be measured against real-data statistics, which remain valid at any horizon, while action following is preserved by the model's conditional generation loss. We propose Fréchet Forcing, which fine-tunes a world model together with its deployed multi-step sampler under three constraints. Generative anchoring applies the flow-matching loss after a self-generated history ending on real data. Context fidelity, a Fréchet distance (FD) on latent statistics of the free rollout centred on each clip's own ground truth, keeps every rollout faithful to its scene. Reality matching, an FD to real frames in a frozen perceptual space, keeps the generated frames realistic. Because all three targets are derived from short real clips without comparing a rollout against a long recorded future, training requires no teacher, no online critic and no long videos. Fine-tuning MiniWorld-1B, pretrained on 253-frame clips, for at most 36 GPU-hours on 381-frame clips yields rollouts that remain stable beyond 4,000 frames and continue to follow their actions in both robot manipulation and camera-controlled exploration.

it_7894b47854cf3f92.title: OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners
it_7894b47854cf3f92.summary: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.

it_5b8693989d703b13.title: Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents
it_5b8693989d703b13.summary: Recursive language-model agents decompose tasks and delegate subtasks to child instances of the same policy, forming a tree of work. Training them, however, is hard: the final outcome is verifiable, but the self-invented intermediate subtasks are numerous and carry no ground truth. Existing methods score each node with a verifier or judge, which is costly at scale and blind to decomposition quality. We argue that a recursive agent must learn three coupled capabilities within one set of weights: decomposing problems into subtasks, solving them, and evaluating the outcomes, each requiring its own training signal. SERA (Self-Evaluating Recursive Agents) turns evaluation into a learned capability of the policy itself. Before delegating, the parent writes a rubric of weighted success criteria for each child subtask; a ranking objective against verified outcomes then trains rubric generation so that the criteria track genuine subtask success. In addition, a complementary leaf-coverage signal provides direct credit for task decomposition. Our central finding is that training the policy to generate aligned rubrics is what drives the gains: because the same weights both evaluate and execute, learning to judge subtasks sharpens the agent's ability to solve them. Notably, external supervision is also reduced: the judge is consulted only to train the rubric generator, while solving is trained against the agent's own rubric scores, which outperform direct use of the judge. Beyond training, the learned rubric doubles as an inference-time selector for tree search. On TextCraft-Synth and TextWorld-Sync, SERA improves over strong recursive-agent baselines by 5.38 and 13.14 points on average, and rubric-guided tree search at inference adds a further 2.43 points on TextWorld-Sync.

it_6c096b15e9b9bd77.title: My obituary for programming
it_6c096b15e9b9bd77.summary:
My obituary for programming
Jeremy Scheff poignantly captures the key loss caused by coding agents for career programmers who enjoyed the puzzle of developing code:

Programming turned into one of the greatest jobs you could imagine. You got paid to work on tricky little logic puzzles. The trickier the puzzle, the more you got paid. But even pretty simple puzzles were worth a lot of money because regular people just couldn't do it! No, they needed us. They would give us a problem and we would solve it the way we wanted. We set the strategy, we made the timeline, we defined what was and was not possible.

If you're a programmer who thrives on building working systems and doesn't care too deeply about the problems solved along the way, LLMs are the gift that keeps on giving.
If directly solving those problems was a big part of your enjoyment, the loss is very real.

Via lobste.rs
